summary: Limoneira Company filed an 8-K disclosing its agreement to sell an 80% undivided tenant-in-common interest in Paso Robles real estate (724 acres with improvements and grape vines) to Peak Holdings, LLC for $16 million total: $10 million cash plus a $6 million secured promissory note. A $500,000 refundable deposit is due within 3 business days, becoming non-refundable after the due diligence period ending July 1, 2026, at which point half is paid to the Company. The board recommendation is not stated. The company expects a $9.3 million impairment charge in fiscal Q2 2026. Watch for regulatory clearance and the buyer's due diligence outcome.
